name: Kamituga

routes.outcome: Official Ministry directory loaded and listed the local Sud-Kivu jurisdiction Mwenga-Kamituga under cadastral/land jurisdictions.
Public BIC cadastral landing page loaded; it states that cadastral data services are available for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu and exposes a public map/search application.
Current public JavaScript exposed the Supabase project host and the public cadastral table name cadastral_parcels_public; no credentials or private tokens were used.
Anonymous safe-field query returned an empty array.
Anonymous safe-field Kamituga query returned an empty array.
Tight bounded query around the exact WUP point returned an empty array; this is a point/extent miss only.
DNS resolution failed in the research environment; no login or bypass was attempted.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: The public table schema exposes latitude/longitude and gps_coordinates fields, but no geometry response was returned. No CRS conversion was performed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: The source JavaScript identifies parcel_number as the public parcel identity field. No identity value was returned and no synthetic identity was created.

sourceFieldMapping.parcel_number: public parcel identity field exposed by the viewer

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: three public GET queries using only safe identity/location fields: Sud-Kivu, Kamituga, and a tight exact-point extent

localCustodianAssessment: The DRC Ministry of Land Affairs is the first-party national custodian and its official directory explicitly lists Mwenga-Kamituga as a local cadastral/land jurisdiction. The BIC site is a separate public cadastral information service claiming Sud-Kivu coverage; it is not treated as the local government custodian and returned no parcel geometry.

qualification.reason: A local cadastral jurisdiction is evidenced, but no bounded anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel identity was returned; adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.
Empty exact-point and bounded table queries are misses only, not evidence of citywide absence.
The Ministry directory proves local jurisdiction/custodian evidence, not public geometry coverage or API integration.
The official cadastre.gouv.cd route was not tested beyond DNS failure.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon was returned.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Larger unchanged HTML/JavaScript and response evidence is under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6908/.
uncertainty: The local jurisdiction is first-party evidenced. Anonymous BIC reachability and public table schema are evidenced, but coverage, completeness, geometry availability, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved. The packet is complete for attempt 1 and remains held for serial review.
